ANCIENTOAK-EXPANDING_FORCE.title: Expanding Force
ANCIENTOAK-EXPANDING_FORCE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Hits ALL enemies if you have [gold]Psychic Terrain[/gold]
ANCIENTOAK-PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.title: Psychic Terrain
ANCIENTOAK-PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.description: Your Attacks that hit ALL enemies deal {PsychicTerrainPower:diff()}% additional damage.
ANCIENTOAK-HAMMER_ARM.title: Hammer Arm
ANCIENTOAK-TRICK_ROOM.title: Trick Room
ANCIENTOAK-TRICK_ROOM.description:
Invert your [gold]Speed[/gold].
Move cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] equal to your [gold]Speed[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
ANCIENTOAK-CHARGE.title: Charge
ANCIENTOAK-CHARGE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Your next attack deals {BoostNextAttackPower:diff()}% additional damage.
ANCIENTOAK-DISCHARGE.title: Discharge
ANCIENTOAK-DISCHARGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
ANCIENTOAK-WILL_O_WISP.title: Will'o'Wisp
ANCIENTOAK-WILL_O_WISP.description:
Enemy loses {DisintegrationPower:diff()} HP at the end of each of its turns.
Enemy loses {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
ANCIENTOAK-AIR_SLASH.title: Air Slash
ANCIENTOAK-AIR_SLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Transform into [gold]Hydro Pump{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold] or [gold]Blizzard{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold].
ANCIENTOAK-HYDRO_PUMP.title: Hydro Pump
ANCIENTOAK-HYDRO_PUMP.description:
Remove all [gold]Artifact[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] from the enemy.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Transform into [gold]Overheat{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold] or [gold]Leaf Storm{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold].
ANCIENTOAK-BLIZZARD.title: Blizzard
ANCIENTOAK-BLIZZARD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Channel {Frost} [gold]Frost[/gold].
Transform into [gold]Overheat{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold] or [gold]Leaf Storm{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold].
ANCIENTOAK-OVERHEAT.title: Overheat
ANCIENTOAK-LEAF_STORM.title: Leaf Storm
